Happy Seeking!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

It's been a very long time since Seeker was last updated. 

I finished college and I am now a graduate. The past few 7 months have been very difficult due to the courses and working on other projects for school to graduate.

Now that I am finished I plan on working on this game and the others I have planned. 

Thank you for understanding the long absence and this game will get back to being the best it can be..

Happy Seeking.

notes.title: 2.1 update is live EDIT: update 2.2
notes.notes:
Update 2.2:

There was a error in a script where if all the stars are collected that it would go to a random menu or the next level. To fix this I rewrote the script to tell it to go back to the credit scene. This was an error on my part.

Added a difficulty for more added replay value.

Happy Seeking.

notes.title: Short and sweet.
notes.notes:
Update coming 1/22/19. 

I’ve been busy the pst few weeks between school and moving into a new apartment. I’ve got 3 games in the works right now. 1st is Seeker, 2nd is a unannounced title and the 3rd is the school project which will be released later this year. 

To make up the past few weeks the game will have a lot of new areas to explore. I want to create another island but between school and my 2nd game I can’t find time for seeker. 

Happy seeking.

notes.title: Update Live
notes.notes:
Seeker update 1.4
1.2:
Disabled the flying in the start and many colliding issues

1.3:
2 stars were falling thorugh the map on some users

1.4:
fixed a bug that would allow you to collect a star then go back to the main menu and play again and still will have 1 star out of 8 stars.

[b]Make sure to scale the resolution to 3840 x 2160 for the best visuals.[/b]


New map.

New areas for the stars.

New graphics.

MORE STARS in diffrent locations.

Happy Seeking.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
I am currently on working on an update. Thank you for all the support and feedback for Seeker. 

More stars to collect

Better water (unfortunately due to the character animations I can not make Alfie swim.)

Moved some sign posts to be easier to find.

Many more fixes to come today or tomorrow. 

Thank you for playing Seeker.
